name: Manitoba
description: South-western Manitoba is Interior Plains below the Manitoba Escarpment (Riding Mountain, Duck Mountain); the Red River Valley and lake-covered Manitoba Plain hold Winnipeg and lakes Winnipeg, Manitoba and Winnipegosis; most of the province is Canadian Shield boreal forest; the north-east is Hudson Bay Lowland (Churchill, Wapusk).
